name: starlight-design-intelligence
description: Brand-led design execution with pinned Taste, Impeccable, Playwright CLI, Awesome Design and image-to-Three.js source modules. Skills and local tools; browser runtimes are separate dependencies.

interface.longDescription: Use one design workflow or call each specialist directly. Includes the existing Starlight design kernel, separate brand packs, licensed source snapshots and a local routing and integrity CLI. Taste shapes the direction; Impeccable critiques and refines; Awesome Design supplies selected references; Playwright CLI guides browser checks; image-to-Three.js supports pixel relief and procedural reconstruction. No hosted service, browser engine installation, hooks, telemetry configuration or production adoption is implied.
defaultPrompt: Use the design toolkit to improve this surface and verify the rendered result.
Audit this interface with Impeccable against its existing brand pack.
Turn this reference into an interactive Three.js study with explicit fidelity limits.
